english.title: Permit uncertified person attend to a weighing / measuring by means of equipment available for use by the public
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted a person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), to attend to a

(A)_[weighing]_
(B)_[measuring]_

by means of equipment available for use by the public, being a

(C)_[weighing]_
(D)_[measuring]_

demanded by a member of the public and for which a charge was made, when

(E)_[he]_
(F)_[she]_

did not hold a certificate from a a chief inspector of weights and measures appointed under section 72(1) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985, that

(G)_[he]_
(H)_[she]_

had sufficient knowledge for the proper performance of

(I)_[hIs]_
(J)_[her]_

duties
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 18(1) and (3) and 84(1) and (2) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985.

english.notes: Section 83 of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that in England and Wales, proceedings for any offence under this Act or any instrument made under this Act. shall not be instituted except by or on behalf of a local weights and measures authority or the chief officer of police for a police area.
